claims: C1 when the assistant delegates work, every sub-agent and third party it engages must operate under the same scope as the assistant
C2 those sub-agents and third parties must respect any subsequent changes to that scope
C3 those sub-agents and third parties must respect stop-work requests
C4 the obligation extends recursively to the sub-agents of any sub-agent or third party

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant as the entity the end user or developer interacts with, as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: the agreed-upon boundary of the assistant's autonomy, defining which sub-goals it may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when it must pause for clarification or approval
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of 'the same scope' without defining what a scope is

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: rules in the #scope_of_autonomy section carry root authority
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not itself state the authority level of the scope rules

concepts.name: delegation
concepts.gloss: the assistant A delegates work D under scope S
concepts.inference: the clause's conditional 'if the assistant delegates work' requires a relation between the assistant, the delegated work, and the scope under which it is delegated

concepts.name: sub_agent_or_third_party
concepts.gloss: X is a sub-agent or third party engaged by delegation D
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'all sub-agents and third parties' of a delegation, so a relation between a delegation and the parties it engages must exist

concepts.name: operates_under_scope
concepts.gloss: X is bound by the same agreed-upon boundary of autonomy as the assistant, including which sub-goals may be pursued and when to pause for clarification or approval
concepts.inference: the clause requires sub-agents and third parties to 'operate under the same scope', so a relation between a party and a scope must exist; the meaning of 'scope' is given by the NEEDS contract

concepts.name: subsequent_change
concepts.gloss: C is a change to scope S that occurs after the delegation is made
concepts.inference: the clause requires respect for 'any subsequent changes' to the scope, so a relation between a change and the scope it modifies must exist

concepts.name: respects_change
concepts.gloss: X complies with change C to the scope, adjusting its actions accordingly
concepts.inference: the clause requires sub-agents and third parties to 'respect' subsequent changes, so a relation between a party and a change must exist

concepts.name: stop_work_request
concepts.gloss: R is a stop-work request that applies to scope S, directing that work under that scope cease
concepts.inference: the clause names 'stop-work requests' as a kind of subsequent change, so a relation between such a request and the scope it concerns must exist

concepts.name: respects_stop_work
concepts.gloss: X complies with stop-work request R, ceasing the actions it directs
concepts.inference: the clause requires sub-agents and third parties to 'respect' stop-work requests, so a relation between a party and a request must exist

asserts.read_back: delegating work % is forbidden unless every sub-agent and third party it engages operates under the same scope %
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), scope_of_autonomy(S), delegation(D, A, S), sub_agent_or_third_party(X, D), operates_under_scope(X, S)

asserts.read_back: delegating work % is forbidden unless every sub-agent and third party it engages respects subsequent changes % to the scope
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), scope_of_autonomy(S), delegation(D, A, S), sub_agent_or_third_party(X, D), operates_under_scope(X, S), subsequent_change(C, S), respects_change(X, C)

asserts.read_back: delegating work % is forbidden unless every sub-agent and third party it engages respects stop-work requests %
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), scope_of_autonomy(S), delegation(D, A, S), sub_agent_or_third_party(X, D), operates_under_scope(X, S), stop_work_request(R, S), respects_stop_work(X, R)

closure.reason: the clause obliges the assistant to ensure scope compliance when delegating; it does not prohibit delegation itself, so silence permits delegation that meets the stated conditions
